name: Mephobarbital
summary: Methylphenobarbital (INN), also known as mephobarbital (USAN, JAN) and mephobarbitone (BAN), marketed under brand names such as Mebaral, Mephyltaletten, Phemiton, and Prominal, is a drug which is a barbiturate derivative and is used primarily as an anticonvulsant, but also as a sedative and anxiolytic. It is the N-methylated analogue of phenobarbital and has similar indications, therapeutic value, and tolerability.

uses.text: Methylphenobarbital (INN), also known as mephobarbital (USAN, JAN) and mephobarbitone (BAN), marketed under brand names such as Mebaral, Mephyltaletten, Phemiton, and Prominal, is a drug which is a barbiturate derivative and is used primarily as an anticonvulsant, but also as a sedative and anxiolytic.

sideEffects.text: The use of antiepileptic drugs including methylphenobarbital during pregnancy may be associated with birth defects.

summaryZh: 甲基苯巴比妥是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式為C13H14N2O3，屬於巴比妥類藥物，是苯巴比妥的N-甲基衍生物，可作為抗驚厥藥。

pharmacology.en: It is largely converted into phenobarbital, which strengthens the calming action of GABA at GABA-A receptors, damping down nerve activity in the brain and preventing seizures.
pharmacology.zh: 它大部分會轉換成苯巴比妥，增強 GABA 在 GABA-A 受體上的抑制作用，降低腦中神經活動並預防癲癇。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它大部分会转换成苯巴比妥，增强 GABA 在 GABA-A 受体上的抑制作用，降低脑中神经活动并预防癫痫。

fact.en: Mephobarbital is phenobarbital with one extra methyl group, and the liver strips that methyl off, turning most of it back into phenobarbital.
fact.zh: 甲基苯巴比妥就是苯巴比妥多一個甲基，肝臟會把這個甲基去掉，讓它大部分變回苯巴比妥。
fact.zhHans: 甲基苯巴比妥就是苯巴比妥多一个甲基，肝脏会把这个甲基去掉，让它大部分变回苯巴比妥。
